acs.text_first_line: Scenario: AC1 The evaluation start and report are narrowed, not redefined (new, D-RCV-60)
Scenario: AC2 One score row per code carries the counts, precision and recall (new, D-RCV-60)
Scenario: AC3 The segment-eligibility and L1 decision request and outcome are fixed (new, D-RCV-60)
Scenario: AC4 The decision-record mapping and the feedback idempotency are fixed (new, D-RCV-60)
Scenario: AC5 The two event contracts are declared with their retry and .dlt topics (new, D-RCV-60)
Scenario: AC6 The route, the fakes and the error taxonomy are complete (new, D-RCV-60)
Scenario: AC7 The contract declares no lake artefact and no daily agent table (new, D-RCV-60)

ops_provided: POST /api/recovery/agent/v1/admin/agent-evaluations (restated from RWB-P10-E1061-CON, narrowed to agent SCREENING on sample SCREEN-S2 version 1)
GET /api/recovery/agent/v1/admin/agent-evaluations/{evaluationId}/report (restated from RWB-P10-E1061-CON, one score row per code)
POST /api/recovery/agent/v1/admin/agent-configs (narrowed from RWB-P10-E1058-CON with autonomyMode L1 and the two segment members)
GET /api/recovery/agent/v1/admin/agent-configs (restated from RWB-P10-E1058-CON, the eligibility read)
GET /api/recovery/agent/v1/cases/{caseId}/agent-outputs (restated from RWB-P10-E2028-CON with the screening narrowing)
POST /api/recovery/agent/v1/agent-runs/{runId}/feedback (restated from RWB-P10-E2028-CON with the decision-record mapping)
ops_consumed: rwb-case: GET /api/recovery/case/v1/cases/{caseId} for the product group, the region and the status (RWB-P3-E2015-CON)
rwb-deviation: GET /api/recovery/deviation/v1/deviations?caseId= for the open deviations (ASM-3572)
rwb-deviation: the raise of a deviation with raisedBy SCREENING_AGENT, answering deviationId and decisionLogEntryId (not named by a source; GAP-2194, ASM-3572)
rwb-source-data: the interaction-ledger read of a case in a window, with the ACE fact DF-ACE-193 (not named by a source; GAP-2194, ASM-3576)
rwb-decision: the sealed entry read of the record written by the local library (not named by a source; GAP-2194, ASM-3573)
events_published: rwb.agent.AgentRunCompleted.v1 (EV-28) on rwb.agent.events.v1 with the retry and .dlt topics, carrying the two segment members and the run facts (ASM-3575)
DecisionRecorded on rwb.decision-record.v1 with the retry and .dlt topics, written by the local decision-record library (ASM-3581)

rwb.document.DocumentStored.v1 (EV-16) on rwb.document.events.v1, declared as the run trigger of the app slice
